{{Top|leg}}
'''Stellar Tribune''' was the second lowest rank of the [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] [[Sun Guard]]. Tribunes were promoted from [[Stellar Legionnaire]], and commanded a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of twenty to forty soldiers.

==Behind the scenes==
In creating the ranks of the Sun Guard for ''[[Galaxy at War]]'', [[Daniel Wallace]] chose names reminiscent of those of the [[Wikipedia:Roman Empire|Roman Empire]].<ref name="blog">{{Blog|danwallace|150|Endnotes from Galaxy at War}}</ref>
